text: (1) A scanned copy of the first page of the passport (valid until after March 31, 2026), and for those who have been in China, scanned copies of all Chinese-related visas and residence permits. (2) Original or notarized copy of high school diploma. For graduating students, a pre-graduation certificate issued by the current school is required (graduation date should be before September 10, 2025). The original diploma must be submitted upon registration. (3) An original or notarized copy of the complete transcript of all courses during the high school stage; Applicants for English-taught programs are required to provide a copy of their IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo test scores. The IELTS score should be 5.5 or above, the TOEFL score should be 80 or above, or the Duolingo score should be 100 or above. (5) Personal Statement: Submit a personal statement of your intention to study in China (no less than 800 words), written in either Chinese or English. The content should include your personal study and work experiences, your motivation for studying in China, reasons for choosing your major, and your personal development goals after graduation. (6) Physical Examination Form for Foreigners: Applicants must undergo examinations strictly in accordance with the items listed in the form. The validity period of the examination results is six months. (7) Proof of financial capacity (one of the following documents: family deposit certificate, family property certificate, income certificate of parents/guardians, it is recommended to be 5,000 US dollars or above); （8）A certificate of no criminal record, valid for six months.
